* Duplicate keys
  :PROPERTIES:
  :X: 1
  :X: 2
  :END:
* Keys with dash and plus
  :PROPERTIES:
  :foo-bar: 1
  :tags+: x
  :END:
* Empty value and aligned values
  :PROPERTIES:
  :EMPTY:
  :ID:       abc
  :URL:      https://example.com/a:b
  :END:
* Unterminated drawer
  :PROPERTIES:
  :ID: 1
  body that the drawer swallowed
* Drawer content that isn't a property
  :PROPERTIES:
  just text
  :ID: 2
  :END:
* Lowercase drawer markers
  :properties:
  :ID: 3
  :end:
